condition: studentized_range.sf/cdf at large q (e.g. q=10000, k=2, df=2) returns 0.0/1.0 because the quadrature-based CDF saturates and there is no specialized sf, losing the representable upper tail.
workaround: For k=2, compute sf as 2*scipy.special.stdtr(df, -q/np.sqrt(2)) (equivalently 2*t.sf(q/sqrt(2), df)) and cdf as 1 - sf.
